# sherpa-swatch-picker

A colour picked from a palette: a button wearing the colour now, which opens a grid of swatches. The grid is native radios in a popover, so the arrows move the pick and Escape shuts it. Will, TODO 904

## When to use it

To pick a colour from Sherpa's palette, the data-viz series: a stage's, a series'. Its value is the token itself, as `var(--sherpa-data-viz-series-border-3)`. For any colour at all, use `sherpa-input-text` with `data-type="color"`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-swatch-picker name="colour" data-label="Colour" value="var(--sherpa-data-viz-series-border-3)"></sherpa-swatch-picker>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-description` | text |  | a helper line under its name |
| `data-label` | text |  | its name, above the button |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | native boolean |
| `name` | text, native |  | what a form submits it under |
| `value` | text, native |  | the colour picked: a CSS colour, as `var(--sherpa-data-viz-series-border-3)`; one the palette has not shows on the button, and no swatch is ticked |
